title: UniMLVG: Unified Framework for Multi-View Long Video Generation with Comprehensive Control Capabilities for Autonomous Driving

output_modality.value: multi-view surround-camera long video (20 s examples)

control_signal.value: 3D bounding boxes and HD maps, per-view image-level text descriptions, camera intrinsics and extrinsics as ray maps, and optional reference frames or video.

control_mechanism.value: Boxes and maps projected to sparse condition images, passed through a lightweight T2I-Adapter-style image adapter; text via text encoder in MM-DiT blocks; camera ray maps; conditions injected into every block.

base_model.value: DiT-based image generator (MM-DiT, rectified-flow loss) extended with temporal and cross-view modules; multi-task and three-stage training; large single-view pretraining.

datasets.value: OpenDV-Youtube (Stage I only), nuScenes, Waymo, Argoverse2; total 1,498 hours, of which OpenDV-Youtube is 1,486 hours.

metrics.value: FID, FVD on 150 nuScenes validation scenes (6 views, 16 frames); controllability via 3D object detection and BEV segmentation, following MagicDrive.

controllability_evidence.value: Reported FID and FVD improve by 48.2% and 35.2% over the second-best method; qualitative text edits (sunny to snowy) and CARLA-to-realistic. Detection and segmentation numbers not in packet.

closed_loop.value: No; autoregressive video generation using 3 reference frames, up to 20 s, no driving policy in the loop.

notes: Abstract is partly garbled in the packet. Controllability perception tables are not in the packet.
